work.title: Keystone KH-508487 appeal packet
work.body:
I request review of claim KH-508487 for my June 7, 2026 St Mary Hospital visit, billed $1,544.29. Your June 25, 2026 EOB denied the claim under PA-17, prior authorization not on file, with $0 plan payment and $1,544.29 patient responsibility. Please review whether the denial can be corrected with authorization documentation or provider resubmission, obtain the relevant provider records, and reconsider payment under my plan. I have asked St Mary billing to investigate missing authorization paperwork. Please provide the applicable plan provision and any additional information needed. Dev Mehta.
Evidence: June 25 EOB; June 7 service; PA-17. No provider authorization records or plan language supplied yet. Provider correction inquiry SM-1004 submitted Oct 17. Internal appeal deadline Dec 22, 2026.
